trigger: Need to audit the mentor proposal objectively against literature rather than accept or reject it by intuition.

decision: Decompose the proposal into eight discrete, testable claims C1 through C8.
claim_after: C1 to C8 active claims under formal audit.
scientific_consequence: Shifted inquiry from monolithic device proposal to verifiable component and mechanics hypotheses.

claim_after: C1–C4 closed; C8 pre-empted; C5–C7 open in supplied corpus as surviving mechanics core.
